selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
致盲你前方锥形区域的目标，使其迷惑地乱走，持续5秒。伤害会解除该效果。

当致盲冰雨结束时，敌人会减速50%，持续6秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Targets in a cone in front of you are blinded, causing them to wander disoriented for 5 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

When Blinding Sleet ends, enemies are slowed by 50% for 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 自动攻击有一定几率产生3点符文能量。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Auto attacks have a chance to generate 3 Runic Power.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 反魔法护罩的冷却时间缩短20秒，持续时间和吸收量提高40%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Anti-Magic Shell by 20 sec and increases its duration and amount absorbed by 40%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的自动攻击使目标的自动攻击速度降低5%，持续30秒，最多叠加4次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your auto-attacks reduce the target's auto-attack speed by 5% for 30 sec, stacking up to 4 times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的吸收效果提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Absorbs are 15% more effective on you.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 生命值低于30%时，受到的伤害降低20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Damage taken below 30% Health is reduced by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你受到爆击的几率降低3%，你的护甲提高6%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your chance to be critically struck is reduced by 3% and your Armor is increased by 6%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: [亵渎 / 枯萎凋零]使其范围内的所有敌人移动速度降低90%，此效果每秒衰减10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: [Defile / Death and Decay] reduces the movement speed of enemies within its area by 90%, decaying by 10% every sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的疾病效果有几率削弱你的敌人，使你对其造成的伤害提高6%，持续5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your diseases have a chance to weaken your enemy causing your attacks against them to deal 6% increased damage for 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 将敌方目标举到空中，用黑暗能量扼住他们的咽喉，使其昏迷5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Lifts the enemy target off the ground, crushing their throat with dark energy and stunning them for 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 制造一个反魔法领域，持续6秒，使小队或团队成员受到的魔法伤害降低15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Places an Anti-Magic Zone for 6 sec, reducing the magic damage taken by party or raid members by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜,  邪恶
自动攻击伤害使你获得吸收护盾，吸收量相当于造成伤害的35%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Frost,  Unholy
Your auto attack damage grants you an absorb shield equal to 35% of the damage dealt.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜,  邪恶
灵界打击的消耗减少10点，且治疗效果提高60%。

 鲜血
灵界打击的消耗减少5点，且治疗效果提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Frost,  Unholy
Death Strike's cost is reduced by 10, and its healing is increased by 60%.

 Blood
Death Strike's cost is reduced by 5, and its healing is increased by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜,  邪恶
耐力提高12%。


 鲜血
耐力提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Frost,  Unholy
Stamina increased by 12%.


 Blood
Stamina increased by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 急速提高2%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases Haste by 2%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜
将黑暗的力量灌注到两把武器中，总计造成[([153.12% of Attack Power]) + ([29.835% of Attack Power])]点物理伤害，并为你恢复之前5秒内所受伤害的(20 / 饮血: 21 / 强化灵界打击: 32)%，至少恢复7.0%的最大生命值。

 鲜血,  邪恶
将黑暗的力量灌注到武器中，造成([153.12% of Attack Power])点物理伤害，并为你恢复之前5秒内所受伤害的(20 / 饮血: 21 / 强化灵界打击: 32)%，至少恢复7.0%的最大生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Blood,  Unholy
Focuses dark power into a strike that deals (153.12% of Attack Power) Physical damage and heals you for (20 / Voracious: 21 / Improved Death Strike: 32)% of all damage taken in the last 5 sec, minimum 7.0% of maximum health.

 Frost
Focuses dark power into a strike with both weapons, that deals a total of [(153.12% of Attack Power) + (29.835% of Attack Power)] Physical damage and heals you for (20 / Voracious: 21 / Improved Death Strike: 32)% of all damage taken in the last 5 sec, minimum 7.0% of maximum health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 召唤一个 [恶鬼雕文: 恶鬼 / 食尸鬼]为你作战。你一次最多只能召唤一个 [恶鬼雕文: 恶鬼 / 食尸鬼]。持续1分钟。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Raises a [Glyph of the Geist: geist / ghoul] to fight by your side.  You can have a maximum of one [Glyph of the Geist: geist / ghoul] at a time. Lasts 1 min.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜
冷酷严冬期间，冰霜之镰额外造成20%的伤害。

 邪恶
天灾打击和脓疮打击的伤害提高10%。

 鲜血
当你在枯萎凋零中时，心脏打击可击中最多3名额外的敌人。

离开枯萎凋零后，其增益效果可持续4秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Frost
Frostscythe deals 20% increased damage during Remorseless Winter.

 Blood
Heart Strike hits up to 3 additional enemies while you remain in Death and Decay.

When leaving your Death and Decay you retain its bonus effects for 4 sec.

 Unholy
Scourge Strike and Festering Strike deal 10% increased damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 制造死亡契约，为你恢复50%的最大生命值，但会吸收治疗效果，数值相当于最大生命值的30%，持续15秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Create a death pact that heals you for 50% of your maximum health, but absorbs incoming healing equal to 30% of your max health for 15 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的符文熔铸的效果提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the effectiveness of your Runeforge effects by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 吸血提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases Leech by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 消耗一枚符文有几率使你的力量提高3%，持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Consuming a Rune has a chance to increase your Strength by 3% for 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 冻结自己的血液，对昏迷效果免疫，受到的所有伤害降低30%，持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your blood freezes, granting immunity to Stun effects and reducing all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使用心灵冰冻成功打断敌人会产生10点符文能量，并使其冷却时间缩短3秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Successfully interrupting an enemy with Mind Freeze grants 10 Runic Power and reduces its cooldown by 3 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 以极寒的能量攻击目标的心智，打断目标施法，并且使该系法术在5秒内无法施放。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Smash the target's mind with cold, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 消耗符文能量的技能会使你的近战攻击速度提高6%，持续10秒，最多叠加3次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your Runic Power spending abilities increase your melee attack speed by 6% for 10 sec, stacking up to 3 times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 受到的范围攻击伤害降低3%。受到失控效果影响时，该加成额外提高6%，持续6秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 3%. When suffering a loss of control effect, this bonus is increased by an additional 6% for 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 死神脚步，枯萎凋零和死亡之握额外获得1次充能。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Death's Advance, Death and Decay, and Death Grip have 1 additional charge.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜,  邪恶
受到的魔法伤害降低5%，你受到的有害魔法效果的持续时间缩短35%。

 鲜血
受到的魔法伤害降低8%，你受到的有害魔法效果的持续时间缩短35%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Frost,  Unholy
Magic damage taken is reduced by 5% and the duration of harmful Magic effects against you are reduced by 35%.

 Blood
Magic damage taken is reduced by 8% and the duration of harmful Magic effects against you are reduced by 35%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的食尸鬼的攻击有几率施加衰弱效果，使敌人的移动速度降低30%，对你造成的伤害降低12%，持续6秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your ghoul's attacks have a chance to apply Enfeeble, reducing the enemies movement speed by 30% and the damage they deal to you by 12% for 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 死亡契约的冷却时间缩短30秒，在其治疗吸收效果持续期间，你获得的治疗效果提高50%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: The cooldown of Death Pact is reduced by 30 sec, and you receive 50% increased healing while its healing absorb is active.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 黑暗突变和亡者大军会召唤一名亡者魔导师，向你的敌人投射寒冰箭和暗影箭，持续15秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Dark Transformation and Army of the Dead summon a Magus of the Dead who hurls Frostbolts and Shadow Bolts at your foes for 15 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 黑暗突变强化你的 [黑暗仲裁者 / 石像鬼]、憎恶、亡者魔导师和次级食尸鬼，使其伤害提高25%，持续30秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Dark Transformation empowers your [Dark Arbiter / Gargoyle], Abomination, Magus and Lesser Ghouls for 30 sec, increasing their damage by 25%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
亡者魔导师使你获得1.0%急速，持续15秒。

多次效果重叠时可叠加。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Magus of the Dead grants you 1.0% Haste for 15 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
腐化使枯萎凋零的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

枯萎凋零每伤害一个敌人，就会使腐化的冷却时间缩短0.3秒，最多缩短3.0秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Putrefy reduces the cooldown of Death and Decay by 1.0 sec.

Death and Decay reduces the cooldown of Putrefy by 0.3 sec for each enemy it damages, up to 3.0 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的疾病造成的伤害提高10%，并且爆击几率提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your diseases deal 10% more damage and have a 5% increased chance to critically strike.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 亡者大军现在会召唤一只持续30秒的憎恶，攻击敌人并释放瘟疫之云，每2秒对附近敌人造成([35% of Attack Power])点瘟疫伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Army of the Dead now raises an Abomination for 30 sec to attack enemies while emitting a disease cloud, dealing (35% of Attack Power) Plague damage to nearby enemies every 2 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
末日突降的触发几率提高30%，最多可积累2次充能。

以天灾打击召唤出一只次级食尸鬼时，腐化的冷却时间缩短2.5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Sudden Doom triggers 30% more often and can accumulate up to 2 charges.

Summoning a Lesser Ghoul with Scourge Strike reduces the cooldown of Putrefy by 2.5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
撕裂敌人的灵魂，造成([450% of Attack Power])点暗影冰霜伤害，并使该敌人受到你的疾病和仆从造成的伤害提高20%，持续8秒。

只能对最大生命值低于35%的敌人使用。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Rupture the soul of your enemy, dealing (450% of Attack Power) Shadowfrost damage and causing the foe to take 20% increased damage from your diseases and minions for 8 sec.

Only usable on enemies below 35% maximum health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 每有一个次级食尸鬼，你的永久食尸鬼造成的伤害提高10%，黑暗突变还会将你的次级食尸鬼的爪击强化为横扫爪击。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Each Lesser Ghoul increases the damage of your permanent Ghoul by 10%, and Dark Transformation additionally empowers the Claw attacks of your Lesser Ghouls to Sweeping Claws.

subSpellsCn.name: 横扫爪击
subSpellsCn.description: 使用畸形的利爪扫击一名敌人，对目标造成 [(攻击强度 * 0.2484) * (1 + 全能) * 2 * 1.144]点暗影伤害，并对附近敌人造成 [(攻击强度 * 0.17155125) * (1 + 全能) * 2 * 1.144]点暗影伤害。

subSpellsEn.name: Sweeping Claws
subSpellsEn.description: Rakes an enemy with deformed claws, dealing  [(Attack Power * 0.2484) * (1 + Versatility) * 2 * 1.144] Shadow damage to the target and  [(Attack Power * 0.17155125) * (1 + Versatility) * 2 * 1.144] Shadow damage to nearby enemies.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
腐化会使你的永久食尸鬼陷入邪恶狂乱，攻击速度和能量恢复速度提高25%，持续12秒。

多次施加可以重叠生效。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Putrefy causes your permanent Ghoul to go on an unholy frenzy, increasing its attack speed and energy regeneration by 25% for 12 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
腐蚀你的食尸鬼，将其进化为畸兽，极大地强化其技能，持续15秒。

凋零缠绕和扩散会使此效果的持续时间延长1.0秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Corrupt and evolve your Ghoul into a Monstrosity, greatly empowering its abilities for 15 sec.

Death Coil and Epidemic extends the duration of this effect by 1.0 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使目标同时感染恐惧瘟疫和恶性病变。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Inflicts the target with Dread Plague and Virulent Plague.

subSpellsCn.name: 恐惧瘟疫
subSpellsCn.description: 一种恶性瘟疫，在24秒内造成([439.11% of Attack Power])点暗影伤害。宿主死亡时会爆炸，对附近敌人造成([184.5% of Attack Power])点暗影伤害，并感染其中一名敌人。一次只能施加于1个宿主。

subSpellsCn.name: 恶性病变
subSpellsCn.description: 一种传染性瘟疫，会扩散到附近所有敌人身上，在24秒内造成([202.854% of Attack Power])点暗影伤害。

subSpellsEn.name: Dread Plague
subSpellsEn.description: A malicious plague that deals (439.11% of Attack Power) Shadow damage over 24 sec. Explodes for (184.5% of Attack Power) Shadow damage to nearby enemies and infects one when the host dies. Can only be applied to 1 host at a time.

subSpellsEn.name: Virulent Plague
subSpellsEn.description: An infectious plague that spreads to all nearby enemies, dealing (202.854% of Attack Power) Shadow damage over 24 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
一次邪恶的打击，造成([135% of Attack Power])点暗影伤害，并引爆目标身上的瘟疫，以35%效果额外爆发一次伤害。

施放恶性瘟疫，或将其传播至附近的一名敌人。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
An unholy strike that deals (135% of Attack Power) Shadow damage and causing your plagues on the target to erupt, dealing their damage an additional time at 35% effectiveness.

Applies Virulent Plague or spreads it to a nearby enemy.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 恐惧瘟疫有35%几率使你心智亢奋，使你的下一个凋零缠绕或扩散减少15点符文能量消耗，伤害提高35%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Dread Plague has a 35% chance to exhilarate you, making your next Death Coil or Epidemic cost 15 less Runic Power and deal 35% increased damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 脓疮打击现在会紧接着施放一次不消耗符文的脓疮毒镰。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Festering Strike now follows up with a Festering Scythe that costs no Runes.

subSpellsCn.name: 脓疮毒镰
subSpellsCn.description: 斩击前方14码内的所有敌人，造成([101.25% of Attack Power])点暗影伤害，并使目标身上所有疫病伤害生效速度加快35%，持续25秒。

subSpellsEn.name: Festering Scythe
subSpellsEn.description: Slashes through all enemies within 14 yds in front of you, dealing (101.25% of Attack Power) Shadow damage and hastening all of your plagues on targets hit to deal damage 35% faster for 25 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 黑暗突变使你与你畸兽的攻击速度与伤害提高5%，持续15秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Dark Transformation increases the attack speed and damage of you and your Monstrosity by 5% for 15 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 召唤或强化次级食尸鬼，组成一支由8名成员组成的亡者大军，持续30秒。激活时，召唤次级食尸鬼会改为根据附近敌人执行命令。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Summon or empower Lesser Ghouls to form an unholy army of 8 for 30 sec. While active, summoning a Lesser Ghoul will instead execute Orders based on nearby enemies.

subSpellsCn.name: 死亡命令
subSpellsCn.description: 次级食尸鬼与你一同攻击，对目标造成[0.30 * ([100% of Attack Power]) * (1 + $mas / 100)]点暗影伤害。

subSpellsCn.name: 疫病命令
subSpellsCn.description: 次级食尸鬼爆裂出内脏，对附近敌人造成[15 / 100 * (0.21 * (([200% of Attack Power])) * (1 + 全能) * 1)]点暗影伤害。超过5个目标时造成的伤害降低。

subSpellsEn.name: Death Orders
subSpellsEn.description: Lesser Ghouls strike with you, dealing [0.30 * (100% of Attack Power) * (1 + $mas / 100)] Shadow damage to your target.

subSpellsEn.name: Epidemic Orders
subSpellsEn.description: Lesser Ghouls erupt in viscera, dealing [15 / 100 * (0.21 * ((200% of Attack Power)) * (1 + Versatility) * 1)] Shadow damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 疫病在持续时间的前75%内造成的伤害提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Plagues deal 15% more damage over time in 75% of their duration.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 亡者大军和冰霜巨龙之怒会召唤全部4名天启骑士协助你作战，持续20秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Army of the Dead and Frostwyrm's Fury call upon all 4 Horsemen to aid you for 20 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜
你的疫病技能和冰霜打击的伤害提高5%。

 邪恶
你的疫病技能和凋零缠绕的伤害提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Unholy
The damage of your diseases and Death Coil are increased by 5%.

 Frost
The damage of your diseases and Frost Strike are increased by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
邪恶
对受到死灵影响的敌人造成伤害时，使其叠加1层，并感染附近的另一个敌人。

 冰霜
湮灭或冰霜之镰对受到死灵影响的敌人造成伤害时，使其叠加1层，并感染附近的另一个敌人。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Unholy
When  damages an enemy affected by Undeath it gains 1 stack and infects another nearby enemy.

 Frost
When Obliterate or Frostscythe damages an enemy affected by Undeath it gains 1 stack and infects another nearby enemy.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
邪恶
%，[亵渎的冷却时间减少5]枯萎凋零的冷却时间减少5秒。

 冰霜
湮灭造成的伤害提高5%，[亵渎的冷却时间减少5]冷酷严冬的持续时间延长2秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Unholy
% increased damage and the cooldown of your Death and Decay is reduced by 5 sec.

 Frost
Obliterate deals 5% increased damage and your Remorseless Winter lasts 2 sec longer.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
如果有敌人在纳兹戈林激活期间死亡，天启征服的力量加成提高3%。

另外，每消耗一个符文会使该效果提高1%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
If an enemy dies while Nazgrim is active, the strength of Apocalyptic Conquest is increased by 3%.

Additionally, each Rune you spend increase its value by 1%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
邪恶
命中时击碎托尔贝恩的寒冰锁链，对周围的敌人造成([105.3% of Attack Power])点暗影冰霜伤害，并使其减速40%，持续4秒。目标超过8个时伤害降低。

 冰霜
湮灭和冰霜之镰命中时击碎托尔贝恩的寒冰锁链，对周围的敌人造成([105.3% of Attack Power])点暗影冰霜伤害，并使其减速40%，持续4秒。目标超过8个时伤害降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Unholy
 shatters Trollbane's Chains of Ice when hit, dealing (105.3% of Attack Power) Shadowfrost damage to nearby enemies, and slowing them by 40% for 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

 Frost
Obliterate and Frostscythe shatter Trollbane's Chains of Ice when hit, dealing (105.3% of Attack Power) Shadowfrost damage to nearby enemies, and slowing them by 40% for 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 消耗符文有几率召唤一名天启骑士协助你作战，持续10秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Spending Runes has a chance to call forth the aid of a Horsemen for 10 sec.

subSpellsCn.name: 莫格莱尼
subSpellsCn.description: 在他的位置施放枯萎凋零，效果区域会跟随他移动。每次造成伤害时，使你的疾病效果持续时间延长1.0秒。

subSpellsCn.name: 怀特迈恩
subSpellsCn.description: 对你的目标施放死灵，每层每3秒造成([6.86532% of Attack Power])点暗影冰霜伤害，持续24秒。死灵造成伤害时叠加一层，无法被刷新。

subSpellsCn.name: 托尔贝恩
subSpellsCn.description: 对目标施放寒冰锁链，使其移动速度降低40%，并使其从你受到的伤害提高5%，持续8秒。

subSpellsCn.name: 纳兹戈林
subSpellsCn.description: 纳兹戈林激活时，你获得天启征服，使力量提高5%。

subSpellsEn.name: Mograine
subSpellsEn.description: Casts Death and Decay at his location that follows his position and extends the duration of your diseases by 1.0 sec whenever it deals damage.

subSpellsEn.name: Whitemane
subSpellsEn.description: Casts Undeath on your target dealing (6.86532% of Attack Power) Shadowfrost damage per stack every 3 sec, for 24 sec. Each time Undeath deals damage it gains a stack. Cannot be refreshed.

subSpellsEn.name: Trollbane
subSpellsEn.description: Casts Chains of Ice on your target slowing their movement speed by 40% and increasing the damage they take from you by 5% for 8 sec.

subSpellsEn.name: Nazgrim
subSpellsEn.description: While Nazgrim is active you gain Apocalyptic Conquest, increasing your Strength by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜
你的伤害提高5%，并且位于莫格莱尼的枯萎凋零中时可以获得5%爆击几率。

 邪恶
你的伤害提高5%，并且位于莫格莱尼的枯萎凋零中时可以获得你的枯萎凋零增益。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Frost
Your damage is increased by 5% and you gain 5% critical strike chance while inside Mograine's Death and Decay.

 Unholy
Your damage is increased by 5% and you gain the benefits of your Death and Decay while inside Mograine's Death and Decay.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 受死亡领主号令，召唤莫格莱尼、索拉斯、纳兹戈林和怀特迈恩四骑士冲锋陷阵，并获骑乘战斗能力。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Heeds the Deathlord's call, summoning Mograine, Trollbane, Nazgrim, and Whitemane to fight alongside you with mounted combat capabilities.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当你受到伤害时，5%的伤害会转移给每个激活的天启骑士。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: When you take damage, 5% of the damage is redirected to each active horsemen.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
邪恶
有2名或更多天启骑士协助你时，你的凋零缠绕的伤害提高20%，扩散的伤害提高20%。

 冰霜
有8名或更多天启骑士协助你时，你的消耗符文能量的技能造成的伤害提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Unholy
While you have 2 or more Horsemen aiding you, your Death Coil deals 20% and Epidemic deals 20% increased damage.

 Frost
While you have 8 or more Horsemen aiding you, your Runic Power spending abilities deal 10% increased damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
召唤你的死亡战马，解除移动限制效果。

在10秒内骑乘死亡战马，使你的移动速度提高100%，不能被减速到正常速度的100%以下，并免疫强制移动和击退效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Call upon your Death Charger to break free of movement impairment effects.

For 10 sec, while upon your Death Charger your movement speed is increased by 100%, you cannot be slowed below 100% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
你的亡者魔导师的暗影箭现在会朝附近至多8名敌人射出一阵暗影箭雨。

你的亡者之主的寒冰箭现在会连锁至多3名额外敌人。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Your Magus of the Dead Shadow Bolt now fires a volley of Shadow Bolts at up to 8 nearby enemies.

Your Lord of the Dead Frostbolts now chain to 3 additional enemies.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 消耗末日突降会召唤一个次级食尸鬼来协助你，持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Consuming Sudden Doom summons forth a Lesser Ghoul to assist you for 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的仆从的爆击伤害提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Critical strike damage of your minions is increased by 15%

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
腐化的爆炸效果会使疫病的持续时间延长3.0秒，并立即造成其原定持续时间内35%的伤害。

腐化现可将疫病施加于未受影响的目标。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
The explosion effect of Putrefy extends the duration of your plagues by 3.0 sec and deals 35% of the damage they would deal over that time instantly.

Putrefy now applies your plagues to unaffected targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
天灾打击、脓疮打击和凋零缠绕对生命值低于35%的敌人额外造成30%的伤害。

黑暗突变会重置灵魂收割的冷却时间，并允许对任何目标使用。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Scourge Strike, Festering Strike, and Death Coil deal 30% additional damage to enemies below 35% health.

Dark Transformation resets Soul Reaper's cooldown and allows it to be used on any target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 召唤一个次级食尸鬼攻击敌人，造成([199.665% of Attack Power])点暗影伤害并使其爆炸，对附近的敌人造成([139.421% of Attack Power])点暗影伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Summon a Lesser Ghoul to strike the enemy for (199.665% of Attack Power) Shadow damage and have them explode for (139.421% of Attack Power) Shadow damage to nearby enemies.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
暗影指引你出击，使你的天灾打击伤害提高25%，并使其为你赋予暗影之爪，最多叠加4层。

每层暗影之爪都会使天灾打击额外弹向一名敌人。后续的每次弹射伤害均降低10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Shadows guide your strikes, increasing the damage of your Scourge Strike by 25%, and causing it to grant you Clawing Shadows up to 4 times.

For each stack of Clawing Shadows, your Scourge Strike chains to an additional enemy. Each subsequent chain deals 10% reduced damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 腐化的伤害提高20%，获得额外2次充能，并最多消耗2层可用充能。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Putrefy deals 20% increased damage, has 2 additional charges and consumes up to 2 available charges.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
腐化次级食尸鬼时有100%几率将其复活为亡者魔导师，向敌人发射寒冰箭和暗影箭，持续15秒。

当你控制3名亡者魔导师时，牺牲它们召唤亡者之主，持续15秒，发射在2个敌人间弹射的寒冰箭。剩余持续时间越长的魔导师赋予的力量越强。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Putrefying a Lesser Ghoul has a 100% chance to reanimate it as a Magus of the Dead who hurls Frostbolts and Shadow Bolts at your foes for 15 sec.

When you control 3 Magus of the Dead, sacrifice them to summon their Lord of the Dead for 15 sec, casting Frostbolts that chain between 2 enemies. Magus with higher remaining duration grant increased power.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜
天启骑士施放的技能造成的伤害提高5%。

 邪恶
天启骑士施放的技能造成的伤害提高5%。

你的食尸鬼和骷髅射手造成的伤害提高10%，次级食尸鬼造成的伤害提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Frost
The abilities that Horsemen cast deal 5% increased damage..

 Unholy
The abilities that Horsemen cast deal 5% increased damage.

Your Ghoul and skeletal archer deals 10% and Lesser Ghouls deal 20% increased damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
邪恶
施放凋零缠绕或扩散会命令怀特迈恩与你一起以125%效果施放凋零缠绕或扩散。

 冰霜
施放湮灭或冰霜之镰会命令托尔贝恩与你一起以100%的效果施放湮灭或冰霜之镰。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Unholy
Casting Death Coil or Epidemic orders Whitemane to cast her Death Coil or Epidemic alongside you at 125% effectiveness.

 Frost
Casting Obliterate or Frostscythe orders Trollbane to cast his Obliterate or Frostscythe alongside you at 100% effectiveness.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜
冰霜之柱会召唤托尔贝恩，持续6秒。

 邪恶
黑暗突变会召唤怀特迈恩，持续6秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Unholy
Dark Transformation summons forth Whitemane for 6 sec.

 Frost
Pillar of Frost summons forth Trollbane for 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当你的次级食尸鬼消失时，他们的内脏会发生爆炸，对附近的敌人造成[0.21 * (([200% of Attack Power])) * (1 + 全能) * 1]点暗影伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: When your Lesser Ghouls expire, they explode in viscera, dealing [0.21 * ((200% of Attack Power)) * (1 + Versatility) * 1] Shadow damage to enemies nearby.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 恐惧瘟疫有20%的几率唤醒死者，使一个次级食尸鬼掘地而出并跃向目标，以100%的效果将其腐化。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Dread Plague has a 20% chance to rouse the dead, causing a Lesser Ghoul to unearth and leap at the target to Putrefy at 100% effectiveness.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
腐化使你接下来的1次天灾打击各召唤一只次级食尸鬼，并使你获得3%精通，持续12秒。

多次施加可以重叠生效。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Putrefy causes your next 1 Scourge Strike to summon a Lesser Ghoul, and grants you 3% Mastery for 12 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 亡者大军汲取亡者之力，将你的凋零缠绕和扩散转化为死灵缠绕和灾殃坟茔，持续30秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Army of the Dead siphons the power of the fallen, transforming Death Coil and Epidemic into Necrotic Coil and Graveyard for 30 sec.

subSpellsCn.name: 死灵缠绕
subSpellsCn.description: 释放一道由亡骨与死灵能量构成的漩涡，对至多3名敌人造成([205.335% of Attack Power])点暗影打击伤害，并对所有被刺穿的敌人造成([64.584% of Attack Power])点暗影伤害。

subSpellsCn.name: 灾殃坟茔
subSpellsCn.description: 亡者在所有感染了恶性病变的敌人脚下破土而出，造成([111.983% of Attack Power])点暗影伤害，并对附近敌人造成([52.6989% of Attack Power])点暗影伤害。

subSpellsEn.name: Necrotic Coil
subSpellsEn.description: Unleash a vortex of necrotic energy and bone, dealing (205.335% of Attack Power) Shadowstrike damage up to 3 foes and (64.584% of Attack Power) Shadow damage to all pierced enemies.

subSpellsEn.name: Graveyard
subSpellsEn.description: The dead erupt beneath all foes with Virulent Plague, dealing (111.983% of Attack Power) Shadow damage and (52.6989% of Attack Power) Shadow damage to enemies nearby.
